summary: Apollo V1 Gate 4 Phone Call Protection (iteration 11) PASSED. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_gate4_call.py against https://threat-patrol-1.preview.emergentagent.com/api — POST /api/patrol/events with category='call' returns 200 (state=barking, scenario=C02); GET /api/patrol/events returns the persisted call event; upsert on same event_id updates headline/scenario; call event with claimed_brand='CommBank'+scent_id round-trips correctly; bad state literal is rejected (422). Note: server responses still include Mongo alias '_id' — carried over from earlier iterations, not new to Gate 4 (see critical_code_review_comments). Frontend unit tests (Node --test): gate4 25/25, gate2 20/20, gate3 18/18, gate3page 15/15 — all green. Frontend UI (390x844, https://threat-patrol-1.preview.emergentagent.com): onboarding-start-button → disclosure-accept-button → Home → home-check-call-button navigates to /call. Acceptance 1 (transfer + bank): call-state='Barking', call-verdict='Do not transfer the money.', call-recommendation contains 'Hang up and contact your bank independently'; verify-caller-sheet opens with text mentioning 'official app' and 'back of your card'; call-why reveals call-why-0..2; call-recovery-open button present; call-again resets to selection screen. Acceptance 3 (nothing + business): call-state='Patrolling', scenario 'Ordinary call', no call-recovery-open button rendered (text 'Nothing to recover from — this looked like an ordinary call.'). Acceptance 4 (install + remote + techsupport): call-state='Barking', scenario 'Remote access request', verdict 'Do not install or open remote-access software for this caller.'. C20 (nothing + bank): call-state='Ears up', scenario 'Possible genuine bank call', verdict mentions 'Caller ID isn't proof they are your bank'. C10 (transfer + family): call-state='Ears up', scenario 'Family emergency money request', verdict 'Verify this independently before sending money.'. Transcript path (other + unknown + 'read back a six-digit security code'): scenario 'Verification code request', state 'Barking', verdict 'Do not share the code.'. Acceptance 2 (cross-gate Threat Scent): message-check on CommBank phishing SMS then /call ask=code + claim=bank produced Barking call event; Home did NOT show a home-scent-* card linking the two events — this is the KNOWN LIMITATION documented in the review request (call event has claimed_brand=null when the transcript doesn't name the bank, so cross-gate scent linking does not fire). Patrol tab lists both events with category tags: 'Verification code request' (Barking, call) and 'Bank fraud message — claims to be CommBank' (Barking, message, indicator commbank-secure-login-verify.xyz). No red screens, no console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: callAnalysis.ts L62-80: C01–C20 branch ordering is correct — code/password/safe-account-transfer/remote/gift-cards/dont-hangup/install/government-with-payment/crypto/bank-details all fall through before generic transfer, so multi-ask inputs like (install+remote+techsupport) resolve to the strongest signal (Remote access request C05, Barking) rather than a weaker branch.

callAnalysis.ts L49-53: transcript signals from extractSignals() (codeRequest, giftCards, remoteAccess, crypto, moneyRequest+threat, identityRequest) are folded into the asks Set before rule evaluation. This is what makes the transcript path drive C03 for the ''read back a six-digit security code'' voicemail even when the user only ticks ''Something else''. Good composition.

callAnalysis.ts L64: safe-account-transfer regex only matches /safe account|secure account|protected account/i in the transcript. When claim=bank and no transcript, the branch still fires via `claim === 'bank'`. Confirmed working (Acceptance 1).

call.tsx L100-108: state pill (call-state), scenario pill (call-scenario), verdict, recommendation, hang-up-verify vs verify button switch, and call-why[i] all have testIDs and render cleanly. Text is wrapped in <Text>. No raw strings.
call.tsx L56 toggle(): ''nothing'' selection is properly exclusive — picking any other ask clears ''nothing'' and vice versa. Prevents contradictory inputs.

server.py L69-70 BaseDocument.to_mongo() pops '_id' before insert, but response serialization uses model_dump(by_alias=True) via FastAPI response_model. That surfaces '_id' as a string field in JSON responses (present in every PatrolEvent GET/POST since iteration 1). Not a Gate-4-specific bug and not causing crashes, but it leaks the Mongo primary key. Consider `model_config = ConfigDict(populate_by_name=True, json_schema_extra=...)` and setting id alias not serialized, or explicitly excluding via `response_model_exclude={'id'}`.

call.tsx L113 Ask Apollo context uses `a.claimedBrand ?? claim` — when claim=bank and no transcript, claimedBrand is null, so the deeplink shows the raw claim id 'bank' rather than a friendly label. Cosmetic only.

callAnalysis.ts L57 basis mentions ''Recent Apollo events (Threat Scent)'' but the current call analysis does not actually consult ThreatScent state — cross-gate linking happens later in ApolloContext.checkCall/recordEvent, not inside analyseCall. The basis string is aspirational; consider making it conditional on whether a scent match actually contributed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (25/25 gate4 unit + 20/20 gate2 + 18/18 gate3 + 15/15 gate3page + all 5 UI acceptance scenarios: A1 transfer+bank, A3 nothing+business, A4 install+remote+techsupport, C20 nothing+bank, C10 transfer+family, transcript six-digit code, plus A2 cross-gate)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test devices in backend: gate4dev<hex> per test — five per pytest run, insert only into patrol_events collection. No fixtures shared. UI runs use the browser-session device_id issued by SecureCore mock adapter; localStorage cleared before A2 to force fresh onboarding+patrol state. No seed data persists that requires cleanup beyond per-device rows in patrol_events.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gate 4 is fully green. If retesting: (1) PatrolEventIn.status literal is {active,trusted,blocked,resolved} — do NOT use 'open'. (2) On the /call screen, `nothing` is exclusive vs any other ask (see toggle at call.tsx L56); asserting ''no recovery button'' relies on result.event being null which only happens in the C19 branch. (3) Acceptance 2 cross-gate scent linking with claim=bank and no transcript is a documented no-op (call event has claimed_brand=null when the transcript doesn't name the bank). To force a scent link, include a transcript that names the bank (e.g. '…this is CommBank fraud team, we need to move…') — that populates sig.claimedBrand via extractSignals and analyseCall returns claimedBrand='CommBank'. (4) Verify-caller sheet close button can scroll below fold on 390x844; use `await page.evaluate("() => window.scrollTo(0, document.body.scrollHeight)")` or click the backdrop instead. (5) call-recovery-open path: pick sheet testID is `call-recovery-pick-sheet`; kind buttons are `call-recovery-pick-<kind>` where kind∈{password,code,money,card,app,called,info}; the recovery step sheet is `call-recovery-sheet`.
rca_of_issue: No bugs found. All C01–C20 branches route correctly, Threat Scent cross-gate is unfired-when-null-brand (working as designed and documented in the review request), Patrol persistence works, and cover all five UI acceptance scenarios plus the transcript composition path. Only preexisting observation is the Mongo '_id' alias leaking into PatrolEvent responses via BaseDocument — carried over from iterations 1-10 and not introduced by Gate 4.
